description: Find companies that meet very specific rules, checked one by one with evidence: e.g. "revendas de peças agrícolas no RS" (source: web search "revenda de peças agrícolas" in RS cities, or the Receita by CNAE 4661300; rules: "vende peças agrícolas, não só máquinas", "é revenda, não fabricante"). Each company's own site (or a web search on it) is read and every rule is judged as met, not met or no evidence. Every verified row costs 2 credits, passed or not; a sample is 20 rows by default (30 at most). Returns the funnel (verified, passed, which rule removed the most, credits per company that passed), the companies that passed with each rule's reason and evidence, and a new company sheet with every row and verdict. Sources: the Receita (registry) for an activity the CNAE names; Google Maps (maps: query and cities with the state) for local and small businesses, shops, clinics, resellers; the web when the trait is how the company describes itself; a company sheet the user already has. Manufacturers or brand owners of a kind of product ("fabricantes de bebidas, cosméticos, pet food") come from the Receita by the manufacturing CNAEs; a web search for them returns articles, associations and fairs about the theme. A rule about the CNAE or the Receita is checked against the company's registration, found from its CNPJ, site or exact name. Each rule is one short sentence, 300 characters at most, with one condition. Rules filter: a company missing one is out. A hot signal that makes a company better but not wrong (a recent launch, an ESG or recycling initiative, a hiring, growth) belongs in rankBy, not in rules: it orders the companies that passed, in the same read, at no extra cost. Not meant for a list the user already gave when nothing in it is to be filtered out ("nenhum critério é eliminatório", enrich, score or fill a table about each company). A rule about running ads (on Meta or Google), the Google rating, the Reclame Aqui reputation, site traffic or having an app is checked against that source itself (the ad libraries, Maps, the Reclame Aqui record, a traffic estimate, the app stores). Only companies that passed are listed as passed; rows that did not pass are not padded in. The companies are saved in one new sheet, each as a company without a person yet.

excludeDomains.description: Domains of companies already delivered that must not come again.

excludeNames.description: Names of companies already delivered that must not come again (with excludeDomains, for those without a site).

excludeSheetIds.description: Sheets whose companies must not come again, e.g. the sheet an earlier find_companies_with_rules saved (its sheetId), so a search for others never repeats them.

rankBy.description: Up to three signals that order the companies that passed and never remove one, e.g. "lançou produto nos últimos 6 meses", "tem iniciativa de reciclagem ou ESG". Checked in the same read, at no extra cost.

rules.description: One to three rules each company must meet, in plain words, e.g. "vende peças agrícolas no site".

keywords.description: Words of the activity when no CNAE is known.

schoolEnrollmentMax.description: Schools with at most this many students.

schoolEnrollmentMin.description: Schools with at least this many students, e.g. 300 for "mais de 300 alunos".

schoolNetworks.description: Schools in activity of the Censo Escolar (INEP) of these networks, e.g. ["privada"]. Only when the companies sought are schools.

schoolStages.description: Schools offering any of these stages, e.g. ["medio"].

places.description: Cities or states, each searched on its own.

query.description: What the companies would write about themselves, e.g. "revenda de peças agrícolas".

places.description: Cities (with the state), each searched on its own, e.g. "Passo Fundo, RS".

query.description: What the place is, as people search it on Google Maps, e.g. "revenda de peças agrícolas".

sheetId.description: A company sheet of the workspace.

categories.description: consultor: consultoria de valores mobiliários (investment advisers); gestor: gestora de carteira or de recursos (asset managers); administrador: administradora fiduciária. Default: all three.

nameWords.description: Words the company's name must have, any of them, e.g. ["family office"]. Only when asked.

name: find_companies_with_rules
title: Buscar empresas com regras verificadas
